name: Eltiro local demand intake
description: Validate local consumer demands, persist immutable versions, archive files and append private receipts and audit evidence.
outputs: SQLite demand metadata and versions; per-consumer JSON receipts; append-only audit.jsonl; processed/rejected files
runtime: local Python 3.12-3.13 on POSIX macOS/Linux; same-filesystem inbox/archive rename
permissions: read trusted source registry and consumers configuration
read inbox files without following symlinks
write host-owned Eltiro data, receipts, audit and archives
data_source: operator-supplied local demands and authoritative source registry; no network
error_model: Fixed receipt reason codes; CLI exits 1 on submit rejection or operational error without reflecting input. Files remain retryable on persistence failure.
test: make check T=tests/regressions/test_audit_wisteria_801.py; make check T=tests/eltiro; make check T=tests
